title: Energy per bit or operation, from Landauer's bound to a memory access (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of energy in joules: Landauer's bound kT ln 2 at 300 K, 2.9 × 10⁻²¹ J (computed for kloom); a nanomagnetic bit flipped in 2016, 4.2 × 10⁻²¹ J; switching one CMOS logic gate, from 10⁻¹⁶ J (100 attojoules) at the least; one 16-bit floating-point operation, about 1.5 × 10⁻¹³ J; carrying one bit across a chip, about 6 × 10⁻¹³ J; reading one bit from DRAM, about 5 × 10⁻¹² J. Data: Hong et al. 2016 via Wikipedia; Ho, Erdil and Besiroglu 2023, table I.
heading: JOULES PER BIT OR OPERATION · LOG SCALE
